screen.第一行，你写什么？: What do you write on the first line?
screen.2017 年 7 月，币安上线那天: July 2017, the day Binance went live
screen.先写一句关于用户的话: Start with a line about users
screen.接。钱先挣着，书以后再读: Take it. Earn now, study later
screen.谢谢他。夜班照上，课一节不落: Thank him. Keep the night shift and every class
screen.另一种人生。你把每一件事都做得很好，只是一直没有离开那间亮着灯的小店。: Another life. You did everything well. You just never left that small, brightly lit store.
screen.同一天，深夜。: The same day, late at night.
screen.只回一张明信片：「加油，年轻人。」: Just send a postcard: "Keep going, young man."
screen.另一种人生。你的故事讲了很多遍，只是没有讲给那个最需要听的人。: Another life. You told your story many times, just never to the one who most needed to hear it.
screen.第一页｜改编自 Freedom of Money: The First Page｜Based on Freedom of Money
screen.一家券商的技术负责人: Head of technology at a brokerage
screen.直接说不行。同一个价，谁先到谁先成交: Say no. Same price, first come, first filled
screen.把他的请求原样报上去，让交易所决定: Pass his request up word for word and let the exchange decide
screen.留下。这是一份一辈子的承诺: Stay. It's a promise for life
screen.另一种人生。你守住了一套从不出错的系统，和一份一辈子的承诺。: Another life. You kept a system that never failed, and a promise for life.
screen.几年以后，纽约。: New York, a few years later.
screen.你去不去投行？: Do you go to the investment bank?
screen.去。直接做交易，离钱最近: Go. Trade, right next to the money
screen.不去。我想做的是系统，不是一张交易台: No. I want to build systems, not sit at a desk
screen.另一种人生。你离钱很近，站在系统的另一边。: Another life. You were close to the money, on the other side of the system.
screen.去上海。自己开一家公司: Go to Shanghai. Start your own company
screen.回温哥华。离家近，找一份稳定的工作: Go back to Vancouver. Stay near home, find a steady job
screen.另一种人生。你离家很近，过了很安稳的一生。: Another life. You stayed close to home and lived a calm, steady life.
screen.那天晚上散了牌局，你做什么？: After the game breaks up that night, what do you do?
screen.回家，把白皮书从头读完: Go home and read the white paper start to finish
screen.第二天一早，先买一点试试: First thing tomorrow, buy a little and see
screen.卖。全部换成比特币: Sell. Put all of it into Bitcoin
screen.不卖。守着当初那一成: Don't sell. Stick with the original tenth
screen.另一种人生。你很早看对了，也很聪明地只押了一成。: Another life. You saw it right, early, and wisely bet only a tenth.
screen.跌掉一大半的时候，你怎么做？: With most of it gone, what do you do?
screen.割肉。止损，把剩下的拿回来: Cut your losses. Stop the bleeding and take back what's left
screen.另一种人生。你在最低的地方下了车，后来看着它开远。: Another life. You got off at the very bottom and watched it pull away.
screen.留下。做一个大公司的技术负责人: Stay. Run technology at a big company
screen.另一种人生。你把别人的交易所做得很好。: Another life. You built someone else's exchange, and built it well.
screen.这一页的最后一句，你写什么？: What do you write as the last line of this page?
screen.「先让他们放心。每周打一个电话，说你吃得好，睡得好。」: "Put their minds at ease first. Call once a week. Tell them you're eating well and sleeping well."
screen.「这些年我欠家里很多时间。等这本书写完，我想多陪陪他们。你别学我。」: "I owe my family a lot of time from these years. When this book is done, I want to spend more of it with them. Don't follow me in that."
screen.「像做项目一样，定期告诉他们进度。」: "Treat it like a project: give them regular progress updates."
